metadataRaw.title: Release THIS Muscle and Stop Sciatica Pain Fast
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to release the glutes—the main muscle group to focus on for sciatica pain relief.

Issues with these muscles often stem from a combination of tightness and weakness that builds up over time. To fix this, we’ll go over exercises to stretch and strengthen the glutes (and the supporting piriformis muscle) for both quick and long-lasting relief.

Each exercise works differently, so for the best results, try them all and use what provides the most relief.

Watch now and fix the sciatica muscle for instant pain relief!
